newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Dalai Lama continues Taiwan visit.
Taiwan says controlling hog foot-and-mouth disease to take two months.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Chinese communists plan joint-forces exercises next month (April)
Meat markets consider shutting down for seven days to rescue falling pork prices.
Dalai Lama says he had informed communist China's government of his Taiwan trip.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan to hold seminar on sovereignty disputes between Taipei and Tokyo on East China sea archipelago.
Taiwan continues to slaughter hogs infected with foot-and-mouth disease.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to open 40,000 hectares of farm land for free trade.
Cross-strait direct links are communist China's main strategy for gaining grip on Taiwan -editorial.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Morgan Stanley lowers investment portfolio suggestion for Taiwan bourse.
Entire world keeps close watch on whether or not United States hikes interest rates.
